status_note: Disabled example for an OpenAI-compatible endpoint on loopback. Synthetic public cases only. Replace model and limits only after recording a frozen run protocol; no dispatch is enabled here.

case_set.role: diagnostic and compatibility set; public since 2026-09; exposure disclosed in every report

protocol.task: run_eval.TASK_PROMPT unchanged (transcription reading; see protocol/PROTOCOL.md section 3)
protocol.image_policy: the stored PNG bytes, media type image/png, no resizing or re-encoding by the harness; provider-side resizing is recorded where the provider reports it
protocol.context_policy: one fresh single-turn request per attempt; no system prompt; no earlier turns; no reference labels; no other arm's output

arms.role: one open-weight VISION configuration, local only; the candidate model is chosen only after its image input is shown by the capability check
arms.notes: This is an example address, not a claim that a service is listening. The selected credential must be set at dispatch. It is refused on non-loopback destinations.
